summary: Frontend-only verification of the global spider SWARM on the home page. Confirmed the swarm mounts globally, first burst appears ~5.5-6s after load, spawns 6 simultaneous spiders (>=4 required), each with a distinct route/direction, they move edge-to-edge and clear back to 0 after ~3s. Verified position:fixed, z-index:60, pointer-events:none, no horizontal scrollbar, no console errors, and that clicking nav (INICIO) still works. Screenshot captured mid-burst.
